gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 283'byung ba de'i phyir te/ dper na lo tog phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa bzhin no zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar phyin ci log gi spros pa bcad nas yang dag pa'i lam dngos bstan pa'i phyir/ thog mar zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis bsdus nas ston pa las/thogamar bla mabazang lasatshul bzhin/ /tshogasabasagargyudasbyang cho gabazhin du/ /mi sdog sems2skyed bslab pa bzunganas/ /mjug kyangadaga' ba rgyasapar bya zhing/ /sgrogagi phyir yang minyamasabaslab bya/ /zhes bya ba 'dis ni cho ga gsum gyis byang chub kyi sems bzung ba bstan pa yin no/ /de yang theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rkyen la brten nas skye bas na/ thog mar bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa tshul bzhin bsten par bya ste/ ji skad du/bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan la blang bar bya/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /tshul bzhin zhes pa gus shing don du gnyer bas ci 'byor ba'i bsnyen bkur la sogs pa byas nas zhes pa'i don no/ /de yang sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu nus pa thogs med yod na rgyud la skye ba yin no/ /spyi'i rgyu ni rnam pa lnga ste/ byams pas/grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /

284 chos bzhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ /zhes pa mos pa spyod pa'i sa la blangs pa brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed ces bya ba gzhan la brten cing gzhan gyi rnam par rig byed las byung ba'o/ /sa dang po yan chod du don dam pa chos nyid kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed ni/ rgyu rnam gsum las 'byung ste/ yang /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rgyu yin te/ 'di la dgongs nas dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ g.yo dang sgyus byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yang bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sna 'ga' tsam byas pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang zang zing gi sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa ni nus pa dang sbyar bar 'thad de/ 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po las/ ji skad du/de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig de yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi yi zla de la/ /

gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 285gser las byas pa'i gdugs dag phul nas su/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed do/ /zhes pa natheṭa/nga ni sngon tshe dman rigs gyur pa na/ /de bzhin btagags pa shākya thub pa la/ /'jam gang dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas stong gi tshul gang gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lo bdun du bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas nas de'i bar du smon lam bsams te sems bskyed pa la sogs pa gang gsungs pa dang / ci yang ma bzung ba'i dbang du byas nas/ slob dpon shān+ti de bas bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa rgya chen po gang gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /rgyud sbyong ba ni chos rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas sam/ byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i sgo nas so/ /cho ga bzhin ni sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi cho ga gzhung dang man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de la smon pa'i bye brag gi rgyu'am sbyor ba'i cho ga ni chos rnam pa bzhi ste/ bla ma la ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag pa dang / tshogs gnyis khyad par can du

286 chos bzhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/bsag pa dang / rgyu'i kun nas slong ba byams pa sngon du song ba'i snying rje sgom pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa'o/ /de la dang po ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid dang zhing dang rkyen du mnyam zhing gal te na de nyid sprul pa'i sku yin yang srid cing / gcig tu na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phrin las bsdus nas bla ma la byin gyis rlob pas na stan mthon po la bzhugs pa la yang dag pa'i dad pas/che zhing khyad par du gyur pa'am/ chung zhing yid du 'ong bas bsnyen bkur du byed pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis rgya chen por bsag pa ni/ skye ba gzhan dang gzhan du bsags pa thams cad kyang sdud na 'dir ji ltar nus par bsag pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya ba la sogs pa ci nus su bya ba yin no/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni las dang po pas chos thams cad rnam pa sgyu ma lta bu/ rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar mos pa bya ba'o/ /byams pa dang snying rje ni rtsa ba'i ma rgyu mtshan du byas nas rim gyis sam /phyogs chod du'am/ cig car du bsgom par bya'o/ /'dir dga' ba dang btang snyoms ni shugs las 'byung bar bzhed do/ /skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can ni/ khyad par rnam pa bzhis khyad par du byas pa ste/ de la skyabs gnas kyi khyad par ni/ phun sum tshogs pa bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i dkon mchog gsum po gang rgyud bla ma las ji skad gsungs pa'o/ /de yang sangs rgyas dang chos la rdzas su drug drug ming du gnyis gnyis te brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa/ dge 'dun yon tan gnyis ldan te/ 'di ltar/

gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 287'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ / ces pa dang /bsam med gnyis med rtog med cing / /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /zhes pa dang /ji bzhin ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /ces pa'o/ /de yang yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig gtan gyi skyabs gnas su gsungs te/ yang de nyid las/spang phyir slu ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /

288 chos bzhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ /dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste/ /thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /ched du bya ba'i khyad par ni/ 'gro ba mgon med cing skyabs med pa mtha' dag gi skyabs gnas su bdag nyid 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin la/rgyu ni/ snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa ste/ de ltar yang / mdo sde rgyan las/'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying brtse las rig bya/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /dus ni/ ji srid snying po byang chub la thug pa de srid du ste/ don du na nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can mgon med cing skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs gnas bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la

gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 289skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du ste/ mthar thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /zhes bla ma dang slob mas rim pa bzhin brjod pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa'o/ /de ltar chos bzhi sngon du 'gro bas mchod cing phyag byas la/ yang bla ma'i mdun du thal mo sbyar zhing gus pas 'dug la/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rin po che'i sbyin pas rjes su bzung du gsol zhes gsol ba lan gsum du btab la/ bla mas de la bar chad dri bar bya ste/ rigs kyi bu gang khyod de ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par 'dod pa de gzhan gyis bskul ba ma yin nam/ gzhan dang 'gran pa'i phyir ma yin nam/ 'o na khyod rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs gdung rgyud mi gcod par 'dod dam/ sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar 'dod dam/ ma dgrol ba rnams sgrol bar 'dod dam/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar 'dod dam/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod dam/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo dang / ma mo bsdus pa rnams mnyan nam/ nyan par 'dod dam zhes

290 chos bzhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/dris pa dang / des kyang ma yin zhes pa nas/ 'tshal lags zhes pa'i bar du ci rigs par lan gdab par bya'o/ /de dag ni smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sbyor ba'i cho ga ste/ rgyud sbyang ba dang rgyu yang de nyid do/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ mi ldog sems bskyed ces bya ba la/ bla ma'i rjes su lan gsum du khas blangs pa'i sgo nas te/ 'di skad du/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs te/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang / tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang /bsgoms pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang / bgyid du bstsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / ma dgrol ba rnams sgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /smon pa'i mjug gi cho ga ni/ lhung bas mi phog par bya ba'i phyir bslab pa'i gzhi bsdus te brjod pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyang smon lam du btab nas dga' ba rgyas par sgom pa ste/ ji skad du/ shrī shān+ti de bas/

gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 291deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa'ang legs par thob de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ / yang /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi/ /rin chen mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i nad rab zhi ba yi / /sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis so/ /de ltar cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa'i smon pa de brtan por gyur nas/ sems can gyi don la shin tu rings pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa bskyed pa dang / gzod 'jug pa'i sdom pa blang bar bya ste/ de yang bslab pa bzung nas zhes bya ba la/'di ni bye brag gi rgyu rnam pa gsum las skye ste/ smon pa'i sems de nyid skyes la ma nyams pa dang / snying rje rang bas gzhan gces rgyud la skyes pa dang / so sor thar pa ris bdun gang yang rung ba'i sdom pa dang ldan pa ste/ de skad du/ shrī a ti shas kyang /so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /

292 chos bzhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/byang chub sems pa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ /so sor thar pa ris bdun du/ /de bzhin btagags pas bshad pa las/ /tshangs spyod dpal ni mchog yin te/ /dge slong sdom pa dag tu 'dod / /ces so/ /'on kyang nyan thos kyi so sor thar pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye ba dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten du mi rung ste/ ngo bo 'gal ba yin mod kyi/bsam pa gnas gyur pas sdom pa gnas gyur ba yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i ming yang 'thob pas na 'gal ba med do/ /gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa las/ nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa las ji skad du gan+da/ngas pa dang /byams pas kyang /bsam pa dang ni bstan pa dang / /sbyor ba dang ni rton pa dang / /dus 'gal phyir na dman pa gang / /de ni dman pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs dres/ /'dir 'jug pa'i cho ga la gsum las/ sbyor ba'i cho ga la bzhi ste/ gang zag gang gis yul gang la tshul lam thabs ji ltar gsol ba gdab pa dang / de nas

gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 293tshogs bsags la bla ma la bskul zhing de'i rjes la sems dang ba sgom pa dang /de nas brtags nas khas len du gzhug pa'i phyir bslab pa'i gzhi lci yang brjod pa dang / de nas sems bskyed dam pa dri zhing khas len du gzhug pa rnams so/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams len par 'dod dam zhes dri zhing / des kyang len par 'tshal zhes khas blang bar bya'o/ /mjug gam rjes kyi cho ga la lnga ste/ bla mas de ma thag tu mkhyen par gsol ba gdab pa dang / ma dag pa'i sems can la gsang bar bya ba rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa bstan pa dang / de nas gzengs bstod cing dga' ba rgyas par byas te ngo tsha shes pas bslab pa la legs par gnas par bya ba'i phyir gdams pa dang / de nas gtang rag gi mchod pa ci nus byas te yang dag par blang ba'i khyad par bstan pa dang / de ltar bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dam bye brag pa blangs nas bslab pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /'dir bslab pa'i gzhi dang tshul brjod pa'i tshig rnams ni blo chung ba'i gang zag rnams kyis bsrung bar bya ba dang / gzhung mang gi dogs pas logs su shes par bya'o/ /bslab pa'i gzhi bye brag par len pa ni/ thams cad nas thams cad du bslab par mi nus pa'i gang zag gi dbang du mdzad nas bslab pa'i gzhi mang nyung dang / dus chad pa yang gsungs te/ sman gyi lha be+e ḍūr+ya'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag lo gcig gam zla ba gsum du bslab pa'i gzhi rnams 'dzin na zhes 'byung ba dang / zla ba sgron ma las kyang /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /sangs rgyas bdag ni bye ba khrag khrig la/ /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba dang / /

294 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/zas dang skom gyis dad sems mchod pa bas/ /gang zhig dam pa'i chos 'di 'jig pa'i tshe/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'gag pa na/ /nyi ma gakhrig gcig bslab pa gcig bzung ba/ /de bas bsod nams 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes byupabs na de dag kyang don dang bcas par gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar rang gi nus pa dang sbyar la khas blang bar bya ste/ khas blangs nas sgog gi phyir yang mi nyams par bslab par bya'o/ /tshul 'di ni/ shrī shārnyi de bas kyang /long bas phyag dar phung po las/ / ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin ci zhig ltar stes nas/ /byang chub sems 'di bdag la skyes/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / / rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes pa dang / de las gzhan du na yang /dngos po phal pa cung zad la/ /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 295mi gang sbyin par sems nas ni/ /gal te sbyin par mi byed pa/ /de yang yi dwags rgyur gsungs na/ /bla na med pa'i bde ba la/ /sems can thams cad mgron gnyer nas/ / de dag thams cad kun bslus na/ /bde 'gror ci gang 'gro 'gyur ram/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu ste/ khas blangs pa las 'das na nyes dmigs chen po yod pa'i phyir dang / legs par bslabs na phan yon chen po yod pa'i phyir/ bslab pa bsrung ba la 'bad par bya ste/ yang /rgyal ba'i sras kyis de lta bur/ /byang chub sems rab brtan bzung nas/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu yang / /bslab las mi 'da' 'bad par bya/ /zhes gang bshad pa lta bu'o/ /tshul 'di yang rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul gyi mdo las/ 'dzam bu gling la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong gsum gyi rdul phra rab snyed kyis/ byangachub sems dpa' de la nyi ma re re bzhin sen mos sha srang lnga lnga gcod pa'i tshul gyis srog dang phral lo zhes bsdigs kyang slar brtson pa dang / de la mi khro bar phan gdags par gsungs pa dang / yang nor

296 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos sangs rgyas gang gā klung gi bye ma snyed la/ bskal pa gang gā klung gi bye ma snyed du mchod pa bas bslab pa 'di lta bu la slob par 'dod na ma bslabs su zin yang de'i bsod nams khyad par du 'phags par gsungs pas/ shrī sharnyi de bas kyang / de lta bu'i phan yon mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ci nas kyang phyir mi ldog par bya'o zhes gdams pa yin no/ /cho ga gsum yang mdor na tshogs bsags shing blo sbyangs nas/sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par bgyi/ /zhes pa'am shog ces pa theg pa chen po'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus pas kyang chog gsungs la/ de bas na shrī shārnyi de bas yul sems can la brten nas bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad btang ba dang / yul dkon mchog la brten nas yan lag bdun gyis tshogs bsags te blo sbyangs nas/ cho ga shin tu bsdus pa/ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 297byang chub tu ni sems bskyed cing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ / zhes smon 'jug gnyis ka dril nas bstan pa yin no/ /'di dag gi mtshan nyid kyang / ji skad du/'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyisakyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes 'byung bas/ smon pa ni 'bras bu la dmigs la/ 'jug pa ni rgyu la dmigs nas dam 'cha' ba'o/ /de yang 'bras bu byang chub la dmigs pa'i blo gros 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan du skyes pa ni smon pa'i sems yin te/ byams pas kyang /sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ / ces gsungs so/ /de'i rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa drug lta bu tshogs gnyis kyi rang bzhin can la dmigs pa'i blo grogs brtson 'grusadang mtshungs ldan du skyes pa ni 'jug pa'i sems so/ /de bas na rim pa 'di yang go rim nges pa can te/ bsam pa sngon du song nas sbyor ba la 'jug pa yin pas/ sems bskyed sngon du song ba yis/ /

298 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar gnyis yin par yang sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon pa de dag kyang dkon no/ /de bas kyang gang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu chas pa'i sems can de dag ni shin tu dkon no zhes gsungs so/ /'di gnyis kyis las dang po ba nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mthar thug par sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'di nyid kho nar grangs nges pa ste/ dbye ba gtī nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang drug dang bcu dang bzhi la sogs par gyes nas gsungs pa thams cad ni/ gnyis po'i grogs dang byed pa dang gnas skabs la dgongs pa yin no/ /da ni de dag gi bslab bya mdor bsdus nas ston pa las/1 // ////no// / /zhes bya ba smos te/ re zhig thog mar smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa de mi nyams shing 'phel bar bya ba'i don du/ shrī a ti shas bslab bya rnam pa lngar bsdus nas gsungs te/ sems can blos mi sbang ba la bslab/ byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la bslab/ byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon mthong ba la bslab/ tshogs gnyis bsag pa la bslab/ 'gal rkyen nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing mthun rkyen dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten pa la bslab bo/ /de la lhung ba dang po byung nas 'gyod pa ma skyesapar/ thun tshod las 'das na rtsa ba nas 'chor la/ ga༈ rnams ni mi nyams shing 'phel bar bya ba'i don du slob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam pas sbyang ba dang / dam bca' bsasbyang ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i mdo dang rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams dang / bla ma'i man

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 299ngag thos shing mthong ba rnams yang dang yang du dran par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sgo mtha' dag nas gzhung gang yin pa'i tshul gyis 'bad pa'o/ /lnga pa chos bzhi spang zhing chos bzhi bsten pa ni/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba spangs nas/ shes bzhin du srog gi phyir yang rdzun gyi tshig mi smra ba dang / gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa spangs nas/ gzhan dag dge ba la 'god pa la yang theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig la 'god kyi theg pa dman pa la ma yin pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa spangs nas/ de dag la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing phyogs bcur yon tan bsngags pa bsgrag pa dang / sems can la g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa spangs nas thams cad la lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar sems can yal bar 'dor ba dang / nag po'i chos bzhi thun tshod las 'das pa'i steng du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon pa btang nas/ rang zhi bar 'dod pa'i blo skyes na 'jug pa'i sdom pa mtha' dag kyang 'chor ba yin no/ /de bas na dam pa rnams kyis dang por lhung ba mi 'byung bar bya zhing / byung na yang dus ma yol bar de ma thag tu bshags shing lhung ba las ldang bar bya'o/ /don 'di la dgongs nas/ji skad du/ rigs kyi bu gang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa 'di la snga dro lhung ba dang bcasakyang nyi ma phyed kyi dus na lhung ba las grol lo zhes pa nas/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims tshad med do zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa yin no/ /da ni 'jug pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdu bar 'dod nas/shā rgya ldan zu da /tazungazu da/ /

300chos bakhi 'grel ba snying po gamu ba'i rgyan/semasazhatso lgocar+ṣanabade///nya :/da :ji rto /shālha //namamakha' 29ba ོbobasgokhi//da/ na de mi//ba ///// 4bsdob:bsnye /bya///zhes smos te/'dir bslab bya tshad dang rgya ma~X da pa ni don bya rgyu'i sems can tshasdo med pa dang / thob par bya rgyu sangs rgyas yon to dang ye shes 3 med pa' phyir theg pa chen tsho sde snod rnams las bslab pa'i gzhi'am bslab tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungasapa yin no//de'i phyir/rgyardzu sras rnams kyirdzu mi baspyab pa'i//dngas de gang yang yad ma yan//zhesahrūngango //de dag kyadī da ltar lag tu blang ba'i man ngag mdor bsdu na/'di ltarabyangachubasems ༵'a ltar gang la bslab par bya ba thamaṭ+wāṃ cad kyang ne du bya zlo semasacanakho nachedadubyadagos kā/srideyulanamamakha ma~Xs gsas r+sha semasacan kunaladus kun tu ste/gi da 'khor ba ma stongs // du rang ngo bo gnas skaṭ+wāṃsdu dang mthar thug zlo na pa dang bde ba thams cad na pa ste/thog marane lha dang r+sha dpal phun sum gas trī sngon du 'gro ba nas mya ngan las 'das pa' go 'phang mtharā thug pa'o//tshul ltar zhe na/ltos med ces pa la sogs pa lan dang rnam par na pa la ltos pa med pa dang / wor gsum rnam

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 301par mi rtog pa dang / byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyisasbyin pa la sogasapa la spyod pa ste/ ltos pa med cing mi rtog pa'i dpe ni/ nam mkha' dang 'byung ba chen po bzhi la sogs pa lta bu ste sred med kyi bus zhus pa las/ ci nas sems can 'di dag thams cad yongs su bsdus pas byang chub kyi chos yongs su shes par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ sems can la phan gdags pa dang / 'gyod pa med cing mya ngan du mi byed pa dang / rnam par smin pa la re ba med par yongs su gtong ngo / /chags pa med par sbyin no zhes pa nas/ yang / rtswa'i sdong po dper mdzad nas de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chen pos kyang 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i lus 'di la rtswa'i sdong po'i 'du shes bskyed cing sems can gang dag gang la ci dang ci 'dod pa/ lag pa 'dod na lag pa rkang pa 'dod na rkang pa khyer cig ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las kyang / 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i lus 'di sgo sna tshogs dang rnam grangs sna tshogs dang / dmigs pa sna tshogs dang / yo byad sna tshogs dang / longs spyod sna tshogs kyis rgya cher sems can rnams la nye bar 'tsho bar bya'o snyam ste/ de don gyi dbang 'di mthong bas lus la sdug bsngal bar yang so sor rtog la/ sems can la blta ba'i phyir lus kyi sdug bsngal gyis yongs su mi skyo ba'o zhes gsungs so/ /de skad du/ shrī shārnyi de bas/sa sogs chen po bzhi dag dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /

302chosabasto 'grelabalhang po gamu ba'i rgyan/ces so/ /ṭ+wāṃyangadangos su phaṭ+wāṃ thogaṭ+wāṃ rdzu'i /rdzu pa yod na byengos lja phan 'dogs la/nus pa da na brgyud nas da pa dan sman lam du da pa /nus pa ṭ+wāṃdā kyang gtī phan blo///ngardonirdzubasdumapa ldan// la dan gyas gnas//zhe~X paX don no//de'i phyir/rnam smin bcas pa bto khi 'bad bya//zhes smos pa na: //de//gi 'dzi'adzi 31 'i/sgrod dag phan yan phyags tsam man pa ra/sbyasagarabonadabagatsodab//thagyi //ṭ+wāṃgatas sdos/san/na // //ma la bya//zhesdu bya ba smos te/dzodikunanishidzhai tu lkor+sha tu phyir pa yin zlos de ṭ+wāṃwo sh+kakyis pa' gsung rab mad dang rgyud dang dag de dugangs zlo 'al ba bstan ba/sa rnams spyaje /bla / rdzungardzu rgyas nas brgyud 'angs pa man ngag rnams las sa par rno' spyisdu pa' dunaṭ+wāṃ//ོོོ 'iri rnyi'aphanayarnyi/ sdarnopabakad pabye ñdzums pa' ṭ+wāṃm ༵ thar ༷ sas/kyis bu byang chubyā ོ sems rdzungs rgyas chas rnaṭ+wāṃs sa zhin lta baX/ /'gra ba thams cad kya chas dkar pa rnams 'phel bar da pas nga lta bu'/ /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 303dge ba'i chos brten pas sa lta bu'o/ /dbul ba thams cad yang dag par gcod pas rnam thos kyi bu lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad srung bas pha lta bu'o/ /don thams cad yang dag par sgrub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i dgra pham par bya ba la mdung lta bu'o/ /'tshe ba thams cad las skyob pas mtshon cha lta bu'o/ /'khor ba'i chu nang na gnas pa steng du 'byin pas mchil pa lta bu'o/ /sgrib pasakhebs pa'i rtswa thams cad rnam par 'thor bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang smon lam thams cad bsdus pa'i mdor bstan pa lta bu'o/ /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin bcas pa'i 'jig rten la mchod rten lta bu'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni yon tan de dag dang / yon tan gyi bye brag tshad med pa gzhan dag dang yang ldan no zhes gsungs so/ /bzang po dpal gyis zhus pa las kyang /gzugs sku mtshan rab rnams kyis spras pa dang / /chos sku mnyam med rtog med brnyes pa yang / /byang chub sems mchog 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur/ / 'di las dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'byung / /'di las 'jig rten bde ba thams cad 'byung / /'di las rgyal bas bsngags pa'i yon tan thob/ /'di ni zhing rnams sbyong ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / dpa' sbyin gyis zhus pa las/byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /

304 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang nas/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'phel/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na byang chub kyi sems kyis rang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad 'byung /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sel/ bsod nams dang bde legs thams cad 'phel bar byed pa ste bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba/ don 'di la dgongs nas/ shrī a ti shas kyang man ngag gi gtso bor mdzad de grub mtha' thams cad la mthun 'gyur gnang zhing / gang gis bsten pa thams cad theg pa chen po'i lam du btsudapa yin no/ /smon pa'i bye brag gi phan yon ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rdo rje rin po che ni chag kyang gser gyi rgyan khyad par du 'phags pa thams cad zil gyis gnon zhing rdo rje rinapo che'i ming yang mi 'dor la dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par bzlog go /rigasakyi bu de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che nan tan dang bral yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon zhing byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par bzlog go zhes 'byung bas na/ ji srid 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe na mtho ris kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'byung zhing mthar byang chub mchog gi rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i sems de so so'i skye bo la skye bar ci zhe na/ dri ma med par grags pas

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 305bstan pa las/ 'jig tshogs su lta ba ri rab dang mnyam pa yod kyang byang chub kyi sems skye zhing / de las sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam par skye'o zhes 'byung ngo / /'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ byang chub kyi sems de su'i lags zhes zhus pa la/ de lhag pa'i bsam pa ma 'khrugs pa'i 'o/ /de snying rje chen po skye ba'i 'o/ /de sems can thams cad mi gtong ba'i 'o/ /de bdag gi bde ba btang ba'i yin no zhes gsungs pas khong du chud par bya'o/ /'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi khyad par gyi phan yon ni/ shrī shārnyi de bas lag bzang gis zhus pa khungs su drangs nas bshad pa lta bu ste/ ji skad du/gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ /mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam pa rab tu 'byung / /'di ni 'thad pa dang bcas pa/ /lag bzang gis ni zhus pa las/ /dman mos sems can don gyi phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyisagasungs/ /

306chosabasto 'grel ba snying po gamu ba'i rgyan/zhes pa dang /rigs pas kyang /sems dzo rnams kyi klad nad tsam//bsal rdzu snyam du bsams na yang //phaspya 'dags bsam ṭ+wāṃ dngaldanapas//bsad nams daXkā da ldan gyur na//sems can re re' bde rda/ci/py-irnyig tu ༷da pa bsal 'aṭ+wāṃd nga // 'ang yan spra dadzo cidalha//bsgrub par 'dad pa smas das//zhes gang ༅da pa lta bu'o//༷ ltaṭ+wāṃ dzi chub kyi sems cho kro 3sum sdis ba/nga ba kying/ bslaṭ+wā sbyi dang rnyi yan gya phyarnyis dzi bstan pa' sga nas sngan 'gra kun rdzab byang chub mas bad pa bshad na ta// ༈da ni dngos gzhi la mnyam bas don dam pa byang chub kyi sems sgom pa bstan 'i'ipa'aphyar/donadamartostso3skuraṣ+ka gotsho//ṭ+wāṃmasnyeḍā d+kushe/smrasakha// sgyuratha/ba/ gab 1 sdob//lothago 45 pas //

gdamasangag phyin ci ma logapalhalhan pa/ 307zhesabya ba smos te/ 'di ni dam pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnamasakyi yul du byas pa'am/ gang mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yul du gyur pas na dam pa'i don dam pa ste/ brjod du med kyang mtshon pa tsam du ming gi rnam grangs/ rje btsun byamasapas/stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnams grangs so/ /gzhan min phyin ci ma log phyir/ /de 'gags 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang / /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnam grangs don de go rim bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni tshu rol mthong ba'i blo'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir rtog ge'i yul min tshig bral zhes bya ste/ lang kar gshegs pa las kyang /rtog ge rnams kyi yul min pa/ /so sor rang rig ye shes 'di/ /zhes pa dang / yab srasamardzal ba las kyang / lha'i bu don dam pa ni tha snyadalas yang dag par 'das pa/ khyad par med pa/ ma skyesapa ma 'gags pa/ brjod par bya ba dang / rjod par byed pa dang /shes par bya ba dang / shesapar byed pa dang bral ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul las yang dag par 'das pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas kyang / dpe gang gis kyang mtshon

308 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/du med/ brjod pa'i tshig gang gis kyang thog tu mi babs/ ming ji skad 'dogs kyang thogs la thong zhes so/ /'o na ji lta bur shes par bya zhe na/ nam mkha' 'dra zhing zhes pa 'di la phyogs tsam mtshon na spros med nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu ste/ yum las kyang /nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ /nam mkha' ji ltar mthong ste don 'di brtag par gyis/ /mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni brjod par nus ma yin/ /de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni byang chub kyi sems rang gi ngo bo nyid yin te/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las kyang / byang chub kyi sems gang zhe na/rang gi sems yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'o zhes gsungs la/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ yang / sems de ni rang bzhin gyisayongasasu dag pa ste/ de ni nang dang phyi dang gnyis ka'i bar na yang mi dmigs so/ /semasade ni de bzhin gshegs pas kyang ma gzigasami gzigs pas kha dog dbyibasasu ma yin/ snang ba dang mun pa dang skyes pa dang bud med dang ma ning ma yin/ sems de ni khams gsum na mi gnas/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched la mi gnasate/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems de ni nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ de'i phyir rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni semasakyi rang bzhin yin la/ sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /de bas na

gdam ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 309sems dang nam mkha'i dbyingasadang byang chub kyi sems ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med do zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na sems de ni snang ba med pa snang ba rnam par dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu'o/ /de yang sngar dngos po yod pa la phyis dngos po med par gyur pa lta bu ma yin te/ gzod nas dag pa zhes pa sems kyi rang bzhin gzod ma nas rnam par dag cing 'od gsal ba'o/ /de yang dang po rgyu yis ma bskyed pas skye ba med pa/ mtha' ma rkyen gyisami 'jig pasan 'gag pa med pa zhes bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnamasabyung yang rung ma byung yang rung ste zhesapa'i don no/ /don 'di la dgongs nasayum shesarab snying po lasakyang / chos thamasacad stong pa nyid de mtshan nyid med pa zhes gsungs la/ de nyid byams pasaganyis po rnam pa lnga spros pa'i mtha' bcu dang bral bar bshad de/yod min med min de bzhin min gzhan min/ /skye dang 'jig med 'bri bar mi 'gyur zhing / /'phel ba med cing rnam par dag pa'ang med/ /rnam par dag 'gyur 'di ni don dam mtshan/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin dang ngo bo nyid gnyis su med pa la dgongs nas bla ma'i zhal snga nasaman ngag tu mtshon pa yin no/ /don 'di la mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam pa byang chub kyi semasasgom pa yin te/ shrī gsang ba 'dus pa las/thog ma mtha' ma med zhi ba/ /dngos dang dngos med zad pa gtso/ /

310 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/stong dang snying rje mi phyed pa/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba ste/ /gang zhig de sgom byed pa ni/ /byang chub sems bskyed pa zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rtogs ldan byin rlabs can gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / man ngag ji lta ba bzhin sgom pa kho nas rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rje btsun byams pas kyang /rang byung rnams kyi don dam 'di/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pas ni mthong ba med/ /ces gsungs la/ thogs med kyis kyang / thos pa dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes pas phigs par dka' ba'i phyir rdo rje'i gnas so zhes pa dang / mig med pas yang byisapa so so'i skye bo dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa yin no/ /ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ semasakyi rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing rnam par dag pa skye 'gag med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i don de la sgom du med pa'i tshul du bla ma'i man ngag gis mnyam par bzhag par bya ba yin no/ /don 'di/gsang chen las kyang /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa brten pa/ 311mkhas pas stong par mi bzung ste/ /mi stong par yang yongs mi bzung / /stong dang mi stong 'dzin pa las/ /tha mal pa yi rnam rtog skye/ /dang po tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /blo dang ldan pas mkha' ltar sgom/ /zhes gsungs la/ slob dpon nā gārdzu nasakyang /mkhas pa'i stong nyid sgom pa ni/ /nam mkha' sgom pa zhes pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / shrī a ti shas kyang /chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar bzhag /ces gsungs pas/ 'di bla ma rtogs ldan byin rlabs can gyi zhal gyi gdams ngag gis don de nyid kyi ngang la gnas pa'i tshul gyis/ bar skabs der shes pa cir yang mi 'dzin/ cir yang mi rtog dran pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad spangs nas/ston ka'i nyi ma'i gung gi nam mkha' dri ma med pa lta bu'i ngang la ji srid gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /yengs pa las rnam par rtog pa shar na/bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ji skad du/

312 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/rnam rtog las ni rnam rtog dang / /srid pa las ni srid pa 'dag /ces gsungs pa'i don rnam par rtog pa de nyid bka' drin can/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/shes rab kyi bud shing yin pa'i phyir/ grub pa brgyud pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag gis lam mchog tu bsrel ba ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /thun mtshams rnams su sgyu ma lta bu'i blos med pa la sdug bsngal ba'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don du/ ci nus pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag cing dmigs pa med pa'i smon lam rgya chen po gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar yun ring zhing gus pa dang bcas par bsgoms pa dang / bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis sems kyi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ ston ka'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha' sprin med pa'i dkyil lta bu/ dag pa dmigs pa med cing snang ba med pa nyid 'ga' yang mthong med kyi tshul du rang gis mthong la nges shes skyes pa ni don dam pa byang chub kyi sems mthong ba'am rtogs pa yin no/ /de nyid kyi phyir/byams pa dang klu sgrub lung mthun par/'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bsnan par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /des cir 'gyur zhe na/

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/33rtogs pa dang rtogs pa de gomasapa'i phan yon bstan pa'i phyir/snangasab ci /spangaga'agata/nga sgo 'a tan///khrosazu she na cas kha/mi //bgra dmakhagethomi kyi'akho//ces bya ba smos te/dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snaṭ+wāṃ bsharabanamun zlo'i tshogs su gyur pa thamaswā cad shugar+shasna~Xgag ste/yul na gnas ṭ+wāṃgs na 'i gnas bye ltar/sems nyad rang ba sa 'od gsal ba rnam par rtog pa ye shes nyi ma shar k+ta spang bya ma rig pa dang mi shes pa'i mun pa'i tshogs gang gaX ṭ+wāṃ dang ngan song rgyur gyur pa ma lus pa las dang nyon mongs ṭ+wāṃ dang shes bya'ajibapa bag swās dang d+kus pa thamasasdu spya shugs sduṭ+wāṃ 'gag nga /thob bya 'ag rten dang 'jag rten lasdu 'asdos pa' ༷na tan gya sa su gyurazlo thamasacad shugs ṅgis hrūng ba chos nyad yanazhesazlo'adon no/ /de yang de bye nyon mongs pa ngang sa'agaga~Xgaparangashugasa~X chod/lta ba rang shugasa'i sa rtogs/ye shes rang shugs sa 'ar+pā ba rje btsun zhal snga nas bzhed pa don no//spang bya 'gag pa'i tso ni/shrī bir ba pas kyang /jiltaralo stong krinas ṭ+wāṃ'i muṭ+wāṃ pa masnag po yang //sgron dzño skyes pa'askadagagaspral//de ban snyor bar krinas ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ gar+sha mthug po yang /rang sems rtogs pa' skad ga ga la //

314 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/zhes gang gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /don de slob dpon nā gārdzu na nyid kyis/thog ma mtha' ma med zhi ba/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /rnam par rtog med dmigasapa bral/ /gnas pa med pa gnas med pa/ /'gro 'ong med cing dpe dang bral/ /'gyur ba med pa 'dus ma byas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis de rtogs na/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa spong / /zhes pa dang / s+t+waṃ shārnyi de bas kyang /nyon mongs shesabya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen por stong pa nyid/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de tsam na 'dus byas kyi dge ba cung zad yan chad kyang byang chub chen po'i lam du 'gyur bas na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan kun 'byung zhes bya ste/ yum las kyang / rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su rdzogs par 'dod pas kyang zhes pa nas/ rgyal rigs shing swā la chen po lta bu thob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu

gdamaspongag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 315phyin pa la bslab par bya'o zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa dang / yang /nga ni shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog 'di dang / /mthun par smra gyur de tshe sngon gyi skyes mchog gis/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus na sangs rgyas 'gyur ro zhes/ /nga lung bstan par gyur ces rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar rang gi sems kyi de kho na nyid khong du chud pas rang la ltos pa cung zad kyang med la/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du chud pa'i ngang nas 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog par gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig la brtson pa'i phyir ro/ /don 'di ni zla ba sgron ma las kyang /gang gi chos kyi rang bzhin zhi ba 'di shes pa/ /de ni ring por mi thogs rkang gnyis dbang por 'gyur/ /de ni bde ba sbyin par byed pa'i sman par 'gyur/ /de ni sdug bsngal rnams kyi zug rngu kun tu 'byin/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /de nyid 'phags pa'i shes rab yin pa'i phyir dkar po chig thub ces bya ste/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i tshogs thams cad kyis mi brdzi bas na'o/ /de skad du 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa las kyang /'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na me ni rtsa dang shing thams cad kyis 'jig pa ma mchis so/ /zhes pa nas/ yang 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ sring mo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang bdag la yang nyon mongs pa med la/ gzhan dag nyon

36chosabasto 'grel ba snying pogasto ba'i rgyan/rdzungs pazlos ༷ dhor ram̐d rno la ༷rtson pa de ni byang dzi sems dpa'i spyan zings pa da pa' sa ri ban+d+ra gshagasaṭ+wāṃs gsungasdu to/ gzhan dag nyan mangs pa lardzu /ra bar byan+d+ra pa na tram̐~X chub dhi dpa' brtsan hrūrdzu yang krog pasbya 'bul la sa 'byung nga / /bla sa rgya mas zhus pa las kyang dan 'ad la dgangs nas/sdo ste k+ṇim mkha' nyon mongs d+dhi ba~X nus// lawa/༷bstan pa//sa tā// seṭ+wāṃr+sha ba 'aX gaX gas pami byang chub mas// nam yang nyan mangs 'gyur nus//zhes gsungs tram̐//deltaradangos dbyeṭ+wāṃn yon sngi sgo bsdu ba dzi ni ba gnyis kyis mnyam snaṭ+wāṃg dun dam pa byaṭ+wāṃ chub 'amaṭ+wāṃ bsgardzu pa ltad spyin ta//'iphyid sa spyad byang chub mas dpa' da pa stan pa la/ ra bstan pa' ra/ṭ+wāṃna~X ༵༵ zlochisagazhas//na/med rje // thagasanamutshoras///ji /rdo// ///pa// lgoro 'ad /zhesabyabazlosate/deṭ+wāṃdīmosadzispyodadzosalagaṭ+wāṃsapa rnamasadzño//kyi mar kun ba byang chub mas sngan du 'gra bas bla ma man ngag ba du kha

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 317na'i don la mos pas ci nus su mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes la/ thun mtshams su sgyu ma lta bu'i blos 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don du bsod nams kyi tshogs ci rigs par bsag cing smon lam gdab pa ni/ zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu ba'i phyir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la sbyor bas na brgyud pa'i rgyu ste cha mthun pa tsam yin no/ /'dir ni sa dang po yan chad kyi dbang du byas nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam dngos bstan pa yin te/ de yang mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa chos thams cad nam mkha'i ngos ltar 'bad pa med par mngon sum du mthong ba ni/ 'od gsal don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de nyid rig cing rtogs pa'o/ /don 'di la/ byams pas/de nas de ni 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i ye shes bla med pa/ /rnam par mi rtog dri ma med/ /'dzin pa nyid dang bral bas thob/ /ces so/ /de'i tshe chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don du rtogs pa yin te/ de yang /chos kyi dbyings ni mnyam pa nyid/ /rab tu rtogs nas de yi tshe/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /bdag dang mtshungs pa'i sems thob ste/ /sems can rnams dang bdag med dang / /

318 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/sdug bsngal dang ni don bya dang / /lan la mi re 'di sems snyoms/ /rgyal sras gzhan dang 'dra ba yin/ /zhes pa dang / de'i tshe ye shes de mthong spang mtha' dag las grol bas mthong ba'i 'i/ma stuXs bya ste/ yang /de ni khams gsum 'dus byas rnams/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog par/ /ye shes shin tu rnam dag pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i don gyis mthong / /de dag med pa'i ngo bo ni/ /mthong ba'i spang bya rnams las grol/ /de yi tshe na mthong ba'i lam/ /thob pa zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces gang gsungs pa'i don mngon sum du byas pa'o/ /don du na sa dang por ji ltar mthong ba'i don de nyid mnyam par bzhag la goms par byed cing / rjes la thob pa dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dam bcu gnyis dang mtshungs par shes nas zhen pa med pa'i snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'o/ /'di skad bstan pa yin te/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi rgyud

gdamaspongag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 319la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gang sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba skye 'gag med cing spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang ma bral ba'i ye shes can yin zhing / kun rdzob tsam du chos thams cad sgyu ma'am rmi lam gyi glang po che ltar ngo bo nyid med pa yin mod kyi/sems can rnams kyis don de ma rtogs shing rmi lam ltar don med pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa rnams la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po 'jug ste/ des kun nas bslang nas sgyu ma mkhan lta bu'i blos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa tshad med pa la ji ltar nus pa bzhin du 'jug cing 'bad pa med par bya'o zhes pa'i don no/ /'di ltar srid pa gsum po gang lasadang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'bor ba mtho ris dang ngan song mtha' mi mthong bar 'gro ba 'di dag ni/ rang gi don de kho na nyid mi shes shing ma rig pas long ba lta bur gyur pa ste/'phags pa byams pas kyang / gang zhig yod pa mi mthong med mthong ba 'di 'dra'i mun nag rnam pa de gang zhig /ces dang / yod pa kun nas spangs te med la mngon zhen gang yin pa/ /'jig rten rmongs pa tshabs chen de ko ji ltar bya/ /zhes so/ /tshogs ni sems can gyi tshogs rab tu mang po ste nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad la'o/ /bltas te zhes pa ni nyan thos bzhin du rang gis zag pa med pa'i bde ba la ma chags par/ phyin ci log gi dbang du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la bltas te zhes pa'i don no/ /gzhan dag na re/ lang kar gshegs pa 'i/tha//nor ba thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /

320 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/phyis ni mtshan mar skyes zin na/ /de nyid de yi nor ba ste/ /rab rib yongs su ma dag bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ tshul 'di mi rigs so zhe na/ 'di ni rtogs pa thob kyang brtan cing goms par ma byas pas slar dngos po la mngon par zhen pa dag la dgongs pa ste/ 'dir ni theg pa chen po'i man ngag las/ ji skad du/ lus dang 'khor ba yongs su bzung ba la nyan thos smod kyi byang chub sems dpa' ma yin no/ /skye ba'i gnas la nyan thos smod kyi/ bsams bzhin du skye ba'i gnas la byang chub sems dpa' ma yin no/ /bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba la nyan thos smod kyi/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas mi ngoms pa la byang chub sems dpa' ma yin no/ /sems can dang 'dre ba la nyan thos smod kyi/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'du 'dzi la byang chub sems dpa' mi smod do/ /nyon mongs pa rnams la nyan thos smod kyi/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mi smod pa yin no/ /de yang stobs rnam pa brgyad kyis mi smod par gsungs te/ khong khro ba med pas byams pa'i stobs dang /sems can smin par byed pas snying rje'i stobs dang / bcos ma ma yin pas lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs dang / nyon mongs pa dang bral bas shes rab kyi stobs dang / yongs su mi skyo bas thabs kyi stobs dang / zhus pa med pas bsod nams kyi stobs dang / gti mug dang bral bas ye shes kyi stobs dang / sngon dam bcas pa nyams 'og tu tshud par byed pas brtson 'grus kyi stobs so/ /zhes gang

gdamaba'ingag phyin ci ma log pa bsnyan pa/ 321gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /zhen pa med pa'i snying rje ni/ stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i shugs las byungab ste chos ladamigs pa'i snying rje gang yin pa'o/ /de'i phyir rin po ches/gnyis med don de rang gis nges rtogs na/ /snying rje skye yang sems can 'du shes med/ /sdug bsngal can la snying rje ngang gis 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /de skad du/ slob dpon nā gārdzu nas kyang /de ltar stong pa nyid 'di ni/ /gang dang gang gis rtogs gyur na/ /gzhan gyi don la chags pa'i blo/ /'byung bar 'gyur pa the tshom med/ /ces bshad do/ /gang snying rje skye ba'i yul sems can gyi tshogs thams cad kyang rnam pa mtshungs pas bsdus nas bcur mdo sde'i rgyan las gsungs te/rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song / /sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs/ /'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan/ /zas chen dug dang 'dres la zhen/ /bgrod dka'i lam la kun tu zhugs/ /

322 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/lam ni rab tu stor gyur cing / /lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i/ /sems can rnams la snying rje'o/ /zhesapa'o/ /des kun nas bslang nas tshul ji ltar spyad ce na/ sgyu ma mkhan ltar zhes pa dper na sgyu ma'am rmi lam gyi skyes bu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sgyu ma'am rmi lam gyi sems can gyi don du tshogs gnyis gsog pa lta bur spyod pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa ste/ don 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i yum las kyang /dper na sangs rgyas sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed/ /byed pa de la dregs pa cung zad skye mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhan byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sprul pa sgyu ma bzhin du bya ba thams cad ston/ /zhes gsungs la/ man ngag las kyang / sgyu ma'i rgyal po sgyu ma'i longs spyod mkhas/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /tshul de gang la bslab par bya ba'i gzhi sna tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don la ji ltar phan bde bzhin du spyod pas na bsam yas tshogs te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ bslab pa gsum/ pha rol du phyin pa drug bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ mngon par shes pa drug byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum bcu rtsa bdun la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing tshad dang rgya ma chad pa rnams te /ji skad du/

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 323spyod pa dag kyang tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad bzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnasanasakyang / /de dag 'khrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ / ji tsam las dang nyon mongasamathar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /zhes 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /rab tu 'bad pa ni sems can gzhan gyi 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ste/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo las/lha'i bu nyi ma dper mdzad nas byang chub sems dpa'i go cha mi bzad pa gsungs pa lta bu dang / yum las kyang / dper na bran mo chu chun dbang med rje bo'i dbang / /de bzhin dpa' rnams sems can kun gyi dbang gis 'gro/ /zhes pa dang / yang / bdag gi bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ /sems can gzhan gyi dgos la nyin mtshan mngon par brtson/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar gshis kyi chos mthong nas sems can yal bar mi 'dor bar brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni skyes bu khyu mchog gya nom pa yin te/ yum las kyang /

324 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/gang gis chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar mthong nas/ /som nyi med cing slob la phyir zhing gzhol byed pa/ /sems can de ni ring nas theg chen zhugs rigs bya/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang la lhag byas yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /shrī nā gārdzu nas kyang / ji skad du/brtan pa rnams kyis rang srog dang / /nor rnams btang ba ngo mtshar min/ /stong nyid lta ba 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu spyod byed pa/ /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar /med byung bas kyang med du byung / /zhes pa dang / yang /snying rje'i dbang gis brtan pa rnams/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyis bred nas/ /bsam gtan bde ba bor nas kyang / /mnar med par yang 'jug par byed/ /'di ni ngo mtshar 'di bsngags 'os/ /'di ni dam pa'i tshul lugs mchog /

gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/32ces gsungs so/ /de ltaṭ+wāṃ bslabakyi pas spang bya sgri~X sna gaṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ bag chakris spyang d+kusapashugs la 'aṭ+wāṃg nga / bsad nams dang sa'i gas ṭ+wāṃnyas gang nas gong du 'phel ba tso de dag kyang sgyu ma sprul pa lta bu yan te/ skadadu rje r+sān byams pas/jiltardusgyuma'isnalapo yis//rgyalapagak+ṣiṃnikyiphamardzultara'i//gang dag sa chas mthang ba /rgyal sras de dag nga rgyal med//ces gsungs so// 'ispyo ོ spyideṭ+wāṃrabyangachubasemasadadri' da pa mak+ta tsam ra ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃn nas/ bye brag tu gnad gnas rnam pa r+sā gnyas su bsdus bstan pa ra/tha datha ṭ+wāṃ shālaba'ikhi//ba/ the:'angal//ba lam smimatharaphyin//zhesabya basmosate/kyi'adisanibyang chub seṭās dpa' gang la bslaṭ+wāṃ ༵ bya ba'isgo zims cad gnad gnas rnam pa kau gnyaṭ+wāṃ su bsduṭ+wāṃ nas/gaphe ra las daḍi ṭ+wāṃ bas lhung ba 'phral du dran par bya nga man par gas pa 'al bar bya ba' shā pa/ //ste/ ༷/bye///|/ tsho mi /rdoX/gto bsrung dag spel la slob pa / shā de ba' zhal snganas man ngag

326 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/yin no/ /de yang byang chub sems dpa' rang la yo byad rnam pa gsum yod pas na/de dag chud mi za zhing bdag dang gzhan gyi don chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir tshul bzhin du bslab dgos te/ 'dir phyogs tsam zhig bstan na/ de dag kyang thog mar rang la ltos pa med par 'gro ba'i don du gtang dgos te/ slob dpon nyid kyis/ ji skad du/bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba skyes pa rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /ltos pa med par gtang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gang btang bar bya ba de dag kyang don chen po bsgrub par bya dgos pas na chud mi 'dza' bar bsrung dgos te/ yang /ma bsrungs longs spyod ga las 'ongs/ /gang mi spyod na ci zhig bsrung / /de bas sems can longs spyod phyir/ /lus la sogs pa bsrung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar ci rigs par gtang zhing bsrung ba yang sdig pa dang nyon mongs pa dang 'dres na lam du mi 'gyur bas dag par bya dgos te/ yang /ji ltar lo tog rtswas khebs na/ /nad kyis zhus zhing rgyas mi 'gyur/ /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 327de bzhin byang sems myu gu yang / /nyon mongs khebs na rgyas mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de dag kyang don bya rgyu'i sems can tshad med pa dang / thob par bya ba'i yon tan dang ye shes tshad med pa bsgrub dgos pa'i phyir spel dgos te/'di ni nyung na 'dis ci bya/ /de bas sems can longs spyod phyir/ /lus la sogs pa spel bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la dang po lus dang longs spyod btang bar bya ba'i phyir las dang po ba'i byang chub sems dpa' shin tu 'jungs pa rnams kyis ser sna'i nyes dmigs dang gtong ba'i phan yon mthong ba'i sgo nas ci nus su gtong ba la bslab ste/ de skad oṃdu yang /tshod ma la sogs sbyin pa la/ /'dren pas thog mar sbyor ba mdzad/ / phyi nas goms nas rang gi ni/ /sha yang dka' ba med par gtong / /gang tshe rang gi lus the(gas la/ /tshod sogs lta bu'i blo skyes na/ /de la dka' ba ci zhig yod/ /

328 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/ces so/ /de la ser sna'i nyes dmigs ni/ zla ba sgron ma las/rus par brgyud pa'i lus 'di dang / /srog kyang mi rtag g.yo ba ste/ /byis pa 'di dag chags pas na/ /de dag sems dmyal mi bzad 'dong / /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i 'bras bu 'di gu gsos yi dwags su skyes pa'i rabs las shes par bya'o/ /sbyin pa'i phan yon ni/ yum las kyang /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod/ /dbul ba dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod/ /spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa thob par 'gyur/ /sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / zan dron changs gcig gi skyes pa'i rabs la sogs pa dang / khye'u lag na gser thogs dang / 'phags pa glang po skyong la sogs pa'i skyes pa'i rabs las mtho ris kyi bde ba dang byang chub kyi mthar thug pa'i 'bras bu 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /de'i phyir/ shrī nā gārdzu nas kyang /longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ /dge slong bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin bstsal bgyi pha rol tu/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 329zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ji ltar sbyin pa'i tshul ni/ gong du spyir bstan pa de man ngag tu byas nas/ byams pas gsungs pa lta bu ste/byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang longs spyod dag /gzhan la mi sbyin pa ni yong med de/ /phan 'dogs rnam pa gnyis kyis gzhan smin byed/ /mnyam par sbyin pa'i yon tan ngoms mi 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshul du'o/ /'on kyang lus sbyin pa ni/ sa dang po yan chad kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin la/las dang po bas ni bsam pas gtang zhing ci rigs par dge ba'i grogs dang dge ba la bkol bar bya'o/ /bsod nams gtang ba ni/ 'phral du bsags pas rkyen byas nas dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo zhing / gnas skabs su yang ji ltar phan bde bzhin smon lam du 'debs pa ste/ las dang po bas mkhasapa'i rjes su 'brangs shing gong du gyur nas ji ltar phan bde bzhin du smon lam rgya cher 'debs pa'o/ /bsrung ba gsum las lus bsrung ba la gnyis te/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i lus bsrung ba'o/ /de la tshe pha rol gyi lus bsrung ba'i phyir srog gi phyir yang sdig pa'i las thams cad nas thams cad du mi byed pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa las/ shā ri'i bu gang gzhan bsrung ngo snyam na bdag bsrung ngo / yā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' phan par 'dod pa 'di lta bu dang ldan pas srog gi phyir yang

330 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/sdig pa'i las mi bya'o zhes gang gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /tshe 'di'i lus bsrung ba'i phyir zas dang gos la sogs pa thams cad kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byin gyis brlabs la tshod shes par spyad par bya ste/ drag shul can gyis zhus pa las/ gang las bsod snyoms blangs te bdag dang gzhan gyi don yongs su rdzogs par byed nus na byang chub sems dpa' de mgron du 'gro bar gnang ngo zhes pa dang / gzhan du na/zas dang gos la sogs bcas pa/ /bdag la sred pas longs spyod na/ /nyon mongs bcas pa'i lhung bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /na ba'i gsos sman ni nyan thos kyi sde snod las kyang / chos gos dang lhung bzed kyang btsong la lus bsrung ngo zhes gsungs na/ skye bo dpag tu med pa yongs su skyabs pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i lus lta smos kyang ci dgos/dal ba phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu ni dkon no zhes pa'i don no/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa'i bye brag la sogs pas ci nas kyang lus chud za bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar bsrung bar bya'o/ /zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin pas tshe rabs gzhan gyi longs spyod bsrung zhing tshod rig la don che chung shes pas tshe 'di nyid kyi longs spyod bsrung ngo / /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsrung ba ni/ shin tu gces pas bsags kyang 'dzad pa'i rgyu thams cad spang zhing bag yod par bya ste/ de yang byas kyang 'gyod na mjug mthu

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 331chung bar byas pas mthu chung bar 'gyur te sdig pa bzhin no/ /de bas na gang dang gang byas pa thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /spyoms pas 'dzad pa ni/ 'dod pa dang snyems pas mi bsgrang ba dang / mi 'phel ba'i tshul gyis 'dzad pas na rnyed pa dang bkur sti la lhag par chags pa spangs nas ji ltar rigs par btang ba dang / mi skye ba'i tshul gyis 'dzad pas na nga rgyal dang khengs pa rtag tu spang zhing gong mar gyur ba rnams la dad cing gus pas 'dud cing kun tu 'dod pa dang / rtsa ba nas 'dzad pa'i phyir zhe sdang gi sems rnam pa thams cad du spang zhing khyad par du byang chub sems dpa' la dad par bya ba dang / thag bsrings pa'i tshul gyis 'dzad pas na ji skad du gsungs ba'i bka' lung la gus shing yid ches par bya ba dang / man ngag bzhin du 'phral du sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya ba ste/ 'di ni chu'i thigs pa rgya mtsho chen por bcug pa bzhin du gsungs pa yin no/ /dag pa gsum la lus ni mtshon pa tsam yin la/ lus dang ngag dang yid thams cad dag par bya dgos te/ de yang sgo gsum gyi sdig pa mi dge ba sngar bsags pa thams cad stobasabazhis sbyang bar byas nas/ nyon mongs pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi man ngag ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms pas spang bar bya'o/ /de ltar rang nyid dag cing smin na gzhan smin par nus te/ byams pas/ ji skad du/ji ltar rma dang zas la de dag gis/ /gzag dang spyad du rung ba smin 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin rten 'dir phyogs gnyis zhi ba dang / /de bzhin spyad pa nyid du smin par bstan/ /

332 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/cheXs pa dang / yang /ji ltar mar me gcig las mar me'i tshogs rab mang / /dpag med grangs med byung yang de la zad pa med/ /de bzhin smin pa gcig las smin pa'i tshogs rab mang / /dpag med grangs med byung yang de la zad pa med/ /ces pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus smin pa'i skyes pa'i rabs rnams dang /gsang chen gyi rnal 'byor pa gang gis bstan pa don yod par gsungs pa lta bu'o/ / longs spyod dag pa ni/ rnyed pa dang ldan yang rung mi ldan yang rung ste/ log par 'tsho ba thams cad spangs nas chos dang mthun par spyod pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba dag pa ni/ thams cad nas thams cad du stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyis zin par bya'o/ /spel ba gsum las lus spel ba ni/ gzhan gyi don nus pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa spel ba ste/ khyad par gyi rgyu la 'bad cing smon lam du bya ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /longs spyod spel ba ni/ tshe rabs thams cad du gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i phyir sbyin pa spel bas ngoms pa med pa ste go ba nyid du zad do/ /de'i phyir byams pas/zong la tshong pa ji bzhin du/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu sgrub/ /ces gsungs so/ /dge ba spel ba ni/ spel ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi gzhung rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin spel bar bya ste/ spyi'i

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 333man ngag tu/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/brtson dang bcas pa brtan par yang / /snying rje mdun du bzhag nas su/ /dge ba spel la nan tan bya/ /bzang po spyod las 'byung ba bzhin/ / riphyag 'tshal la sogs gus pas bya/ /dad pa la sogs rtag tu sgom/ /byams dang sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ /dus rnams kun tu sems can don/ /chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med/ /byang chub sems ni mdor bsdus na/ /bsod nams spel ba'i rgyu yin no/ /zhes pa dang / de'i thog tu gsang sngags kyi sgo nas spyad pa spyod par 'dod pas bla ma la gus shing bsnyen bkur sngon du 'gro bas/ dbang dang byin rlabs kyis rgyud smin cing rtogs par byas nas lam rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa la tshul bzhin du 'bad pa'i sgo nas te/ ji skad du/sgrub po'i yon to rgya chen po/ /kha cig brjod par ga la nus/ /stong phrag brgya yi dod 'gyur min/ /

334chosabasto 'grel ba snying pogarmu ba'i rgyan/lhas gsungs pa daḍi /thu3sa rje r+pā po 'aṭ+wāṃgs pa spyan ras gzikros dardzung phyupy-i mawo bzung ba' phan yayi nga /deyang ga sngakyis bgrangs pa'a'i phan rdzun n+d+ra du matrī gang gak+ṣiṃs paltabu'/ / ༈ra gnabye kya snanas rdzucu gnyas pa 'ad la tshul lta ba ba bslabs pas lam gya mthar na sa bya'//tshula'agyi / wo 'kho'i da //thab ( da thobangathebatab spang//zhes sngi ba ni/tram̐ rje theg pa ba rnams kyis kyang bslaṭ+wā dgos mod kyi/ 'on stang swām rdum pa 3nyas yaspya lagadangabacas patshulabanalja~Xsasus+t+rings pa nyak+ta dṛs sgam pa yangs su rdzags parakaurabaragasungasar+shadegar+sha'atripar/skaṭ+wāṃdu+o/ 'phags pa spyan ras gadhis skyang phyug sa ban kros ḍi spyan ོna pa las gzungs sngags lan ga thas pa dāng /ṭ+wāṃnapadang zlorjad pa' rdzun yan gsuṭīs pa dang /dpal gsaze ba swās pa'aṭ+wāṃ da py-i las gig pa gh+rang /na rdzu byuji ba' hūm̐l gsungasardzultasna/rje/ k+tor ༵ brag tshuswā gyas rdzu spyad /zisdiX ba dang dngas ga dang sa kya tshul sa yang dag pa' lam dngas tsād na ta// ༈da ni lam des bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/de skarjor+shadzor+shagayo//tho/tshopa bgan 〈〈snas/

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 335thashe / /the rdo ༷//ཿpa// /rdo rngos 'a khrin thothababathag /sa /zhes bya ba smos te/ 'dis ni slar yang lam bgrod pa'i tshul phyin ci ma log pa'i tshul gyis lam dang 'bras bu mtshams sbyar ba tsam bstan pa yin no/ /de yang de ltar zhes pa ni gong du bstan pa de ltar 'chad pa po thabs mkhas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i rtogs ldan byin rlabs can/ nyan pa po rgyud yongs su dag pa'i slob ma skal ldan tshe 'di blos bto nas bla ma sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes rgyud la skyes pa/ mnyan bya brgyud pa'i gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa gsum rten 'brel 'dzoms nas/ mawo nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma des thog mar yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de lta bu la bsten te/ shes bya dngos po'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa don spyi'i rnam pa tsam blo la nges par byas pa'am/ kha cig dbang dus su nyams su myong zhing rtogs nas/ da lam dngos nyams su len pa la sbyor ba byams pa dang snying rje sngon du 'gro bas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems brtan por bzung nas/ de sngon du 'gro bas dngos gzhi la don dam pa byang chub kyi sems 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog cing /rjes la sgyu ma lta bu'i blos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i tshul de dag thams cad kyang thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug par bslab dgos so zhes bstan pa yin no/ /

336 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/de yang las dang po bas dper na mi lam du 'gro ba na rkang pa gnyis res mos su 'dor ba bzhin du mos pas spyod pa'i sa la thabs dang shes rab res 'jog tu zung 'jug tu bslab cing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam sa dang po nas bzung ste/mthong ba dang sgom pa dang mi slob pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa ji srid 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa mngon du ma byas kyi bar du ni/ ji ltar bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba na gshog pa gnyis dus gcig la brkyang nas 'gro ba ltar/ cig car zung du 'jug pas lam bgrod par bya'o zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar thams cad nas thams cad du zung du 'jug dgos pas na/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa las kyang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dag gi /ma ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /pha ni thababasal mkhas pa ste/ /'dren pa rnams ni de las skyes/ /zhes pa dang / 'phags pa ga ya tre/ ri las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam ni mdor bsdu na rnam pa gnyis te gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thabs dang shes rab bo zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'dir las dang po ba'i zung 'jug gi tshul ni/gong du bstan pa'i spyor ba ni thabs/ dngos gzhi ni shes rab/ rjes ni thabs/ de la rgyas 'debs pa ni shes rab bo/ /yang rjes spyod sbyin pa lta bu phyogs gcig la mtshon na/ sngon du slong mo ba mthong na byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyis ci rigs pa ltos pa med par byin nas smon lam tshul bzhin du 'debs pa ni thabs/

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 337gang gis sbyinadang gang la sbyin/ /sbyin pa ji ltar mi dmigs pa/ /sbyin pa dus gsum mnyam pa yis/ /sbyin bdag rnams la yongs rdzogs shog /ces pa'i tshul du yon spyong ba de shes rab bo/ /gsang chen gyi tshul la yang / dang po tshad med pa bzhi sngon du 'gro bsabla ma dag pa'i cho ga yan lag bdun gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing sems kyi rgyud sbyong ba de thabs/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs brtags pa dang rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid kyi don sgom pa de shes rab/de'i ngang nas cho ga'i rim pa ltar sgyu ma lta bu'i lha'i sku spro ba dang bsdu ba'i lus can bskyed pa'i rim pa bsdus pa sgom pa de thabs/ mtshan bcas sam mtshan med kyi man ngag gis lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i don sgom pa de shes rab/ de nas rig sngags kyi bzlas pa sgra brag cha lta bu la don skye ba med pas lhag pa'i lha'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul zhing / des 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las dang dngos grub ma lus pa sgrub la/ thun mtshams su mkhas pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas bsod nams 'gro ba'i don du byang chub chen por bsngo zhing mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas pa ni thabs so/ /'phags pa'i sa la cig car du zung du 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus na yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu rgyu zhing sems can tshad med pa yongs su smin par nus

338 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/la/ rjes thob la 'jig rten pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bus mngon par shes pa drug gis rnam par brtse zhing / sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa mchod pa dang / sems can tshad med pa smin par mdzad pa'i tshe na'ang mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngang de nyid las ma g.yos pas na thams cad du cig car zung du 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /don 'di ni 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa las/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyor ba yang dag phul ni/ gang shes rab kyi shes pas bdag med pa dang / sems can dang srog dang gso ba dang gang zag dang skyes bu med par yang sbyor la/ thabs kyi shes pas semasacan yongs su smin par yang spyor ba dang / shes rab kyi shes pas zhing thams cad nam mkha' bzhin du yang spyor la/ thabs kyi shes pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su spyong bar yang byed pa dang / zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /don de nyid gsang chen gyi rgyud las kyang /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /shes rab ces byar rab tu grags/ /yid bzhin nor ltar sems can don/ /ma lus byed pa snying rje ste/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de las gzhan du mi rkang pa ya gcig chag pa'am bya ga rtog pa gcig chag pas gar yang mi phyin pa ltar/ shrī a ti shas kyang dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa khungs su drangs nas/

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 339thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab dang / /shes rab bral ba'i thabs dag kyang / /gang phyir 'ching ba zhes gsungs pa/ /de bas gnyis ka spang mi bya/ /zhes pa dang / yang /thabs goms dbang gis bdag nyid kyis/ /gang zhig shes rab rnam bsgom pa/ /des ni byang chub myur thob kyi/ /bdag med gcig pu bsgoms pas min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /don du na/ gang dag shes rab kyi mig dang bral ba phyin ci log gi blo can du gyur te bdag tu mngon par zhen pa las sna tshogs byed pa ni 'khor bar rab tu 'khyam par 'gyur la/ gang dag chos thams cad stong par zhen cing snying rje chen po dang mi ldan pa ni rang 'ba' zhig thar bar 'dod pas sems can gyi don las nyams shing nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes slob dpon ka ma la shi las gsungs pa yin no/ /'on kyang las dang po pas ni thabs la gtso bor bslab par bya ste/ shrī nā gārdzunas kyang /de nyid 'tshol la thog mar ni/ /thams cad yod ces brjod par bya/ /

340 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/don rnams rtogs shing chags med la/ /phyis ni rnam par dben don no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don khong du chud par bya'o/ /tshul des tshogs gnyis ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyis bsdus pa ste/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum mam dam pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi rgyu'i tshogs yin pas tshogs zhes bya'o/ /de skad du/ shrī nā gārdzu nas/chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdus na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'byung / /gzugs kyi sku ni mdor bsdus na/ /rgyal po bsod nams tshogs las 'byung / /zhes gdams so/ /de dag kyang mos pas spyod pa'i sa la zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas sgom pa ste/ de yang byams pas/ ji skad du/bskal pa grangs med nges 'byung zhing / /mos pa rnam par 'phel byed pas/ /ji ltar chu yis rgya mtsho bzhin/ /dge chos rnams kyis yang dag rdzogs/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs te/ tshogs lam chung ngu'i dus su bden pa bzhi la

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 341dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi la gnas nas/ 'bring la mi dge ba spong ba dang / dge ba nyams su len pa'i brtson 'grus yang dag par sbong ba bzhi nyams su blangs te/ tshogs lam chen po la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ de yang chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin chu dwangs pa lta bu la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar sprul pa'i sku las/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mnos nas ji lta bar bsgoms pas spyor ba'i lam nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i yan lag bzhi la rim gyis 'jug ste/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lngas lam bgrod pa yin no/ /de yang drod kyi dus na snang ba sems tsam du rtogs la/rtse mor rtogs pa de nyid gong nas gong du 'phel te/ bzod par gzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang skyes nas/ chos mchog tu 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ste/ des kyang mthong ba'i lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes me dang 'dra ba skye ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba g.yo ba'i rtse mor gyur pa dang / gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la mi skrag par rjes su mthun par bzod pa thob pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog gam mthar thug pas na de skad ces bya'o/ /de dag la ming gzhan yang / snang ba thob pa dang / snang ba mched pa dang / rjes su mthun pa'i bzod pa dang / de ma thag pa'am stan gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces kyang bya'o/ /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis bgrod pa ste/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa sngar 'dris pa ma yin pa'i don chos thams cad nam mkha'i ngos ltar 'bad pa med par mngon sum du mthong ba ni mthong ba'i

342 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying pogasal ba'i rgyan/lam zhes bya ba ste/ ji skad du/'di de gnas yongs gyur pa ste/ /sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ /'di de bskal pa dpag med kyis/ /shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gang gsungs pa'i don no/ /sa de la chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don rtogs pa ste/ bdag dang sems can thams cad lam mnyam pa nyid kyi sems thob pa'o/ /de nas sa gnyis pa yan chad du sgom pa'i lam 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis bgrod pa yin te/ de yang sa dang por ji ltar mthong ba'i don de sa dgur goms par byas pas yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin la/ de'i shugs la 'brul pa sa bon dang bcas pa ni spang bya nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'gag pa yin no/ /don 'di ni/ byams pas/ ji skad du/mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la/ /yang dang yang du sems pa dang / /'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam/ /zhes gsungs so/ 9gle nā gārdzu nas kyang /ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba ni/ /rim gyis rim gyis 'phel ba ltar/ /

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa/ 343de bzhin sa la zhugs rnams kyang / /rim gyis rim gyis 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad do/ /rjes la thob pa dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyis/ chos thams cad sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang mtshungs par mngon sum du rtogs nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa de yang dpag tu med pa bzhis bsdus pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa tshad med pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing spyong /sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i tshul gyis smon lam gyi mthar 'byin pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so/ /de skad du yang / byams pas/dka' spyod dpag med brgya phrag dang / /dpag tu med pa'i dus dang ni/ /dpag med sgrib pa zad pa las/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje theg pa ba rnams kyis ni spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du gyur nas kyang thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa sgyu ma lta bu la brten nas 'od gsal gyi rtsal spyong zhing phrin las rnam pa bzhis sems can gyi don byed de/ de yang spyod pa bzhi'i rim pas gong nas gong du bogs 'byin cing rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pas/

344 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/rtse gcig dang / spros bral dang / du ma ro gcig dang / sgom du med pa'am mnyam gzhag chen po zhes bya ba'i rim pas lam mthar 'byin pa yin no/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' kha cig cig car du 'jug pa yang yod de/ gsang chen gyi tshul gyis sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyi ngo bo nyid rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa la tshul bzhin bslabs pas lam dang 'jug pa bde bas lam bgrod de tshe gcig la sogs pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed pa ni gsang chen du sangs rgyas pa zhes bya'o/ /sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyis 'tshangagyob ni grags chen du sangs rgyas pa zhes bya'o/ /yang yum las/ byang chub sems dpa' kha cig ni sems dang po bskyed pa nyid kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chosakyi 'khor lo bskor te/ sems can tshad med grangs med pa yongs su smin par byas nas/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang / dam pa'i chos bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par gnas pa yang yod do zhes gang gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /phal cher rim gyis 'jug pa yin te/ de yang rgyal po lta bu dang lug rdzi lta bu gnyis su grags so/ /de la rgyal po lta bu ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa lam dang 'jug pa bde bas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshangargya ba dag ste/ sems can bsod nams bsags pa rnams bsdus nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rang gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po lta bu dka' ba'i spyod pa dpag tu med pas sems can shin tu ma dag pa gang sangs rgyas kyis zhing stong pa rnams su bor ba snyigs ma rnamasatshul lam thabs sna tshogs kyisasmin par byas te/

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pahāltan pa/ 345snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma dag pa 'dzin pa rnams te/ de ltar spyod pa ni shin tu dkon zhing bya dka' ba ste/ ji skad du/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/ skyes bu dam pa drug ma gtogs pa gang nga dang mtshungs par dka' ba spyod pa ni 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la'ang ma byung la da ltar yang med de/ ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sogs pa ltar spyod pa ni/ lug rdzi lta bu zhesabya ste/ 'jam dpal gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa las/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par bltas na sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams med cing sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyang bdag gis byang chub la bkod pa 'ba' zhig tu ma gyur bar bdag mngon par sangs rgyasan bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bslus pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi skyes bu'i rtsal ni de lta bu lags theg zhes gang 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /tshul des gnyen po ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa ni mthar phyin pa'am mi slob pa'i lam zhes bya ste/ gnyen po des spang bya sgrib pa gnyis sa bon dang bcas pa spangs pa ni/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor pa thams cad bcom pa'o/ /de yang byams pas/rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rtog pas mi shigasathob nas ni/ /

346ṣ+pebasto 'grel balhang po gamu ba'i ༅/ṭ+wāṃnas gtīzlo zlo mthar thug pa//ba pa kun da dang // lho gang gsungs pa'o//de nyid shrī nā gārdzu nas kyang /ni ltar brdo lnga'i kyā ba ni//sdongar+sha su rdzakris shang gsal ba ltar//cho ba'inasaya zitharasnan//sa kya sku yang rdzags nga gsal//the ba ༷ /rgo// 'dzi 'i 'i 'i 'dzi 'idaltaralamabagrad sna' tshulayekaucakyimalagapaswālam dang stos bu' maṣ+pes sbyar nas/ da sku dang sa sa bsdus pa' 'bras bu dngas bstan pa thuXg/ 'dzi bye:wa/ 'dzi/) 'iphyithag mar rang dan phun sum sa pa chas sku bstan pa' ra/zhi//drolhami//cha /sdu da //par/mishe wonāb//dgasag ldanazangachub //zhesabya ba smosahūṃ /'dis ni spangs pa dar+sha ṭ+wāṃshesaphurnyi suṭ+wāṃ tshogs ṭ+wāṃ'i chos sdi sku ngos bzung ba yan no/ /'on kyang don 'a bsam sa khyab pa gnas yan

gdamasangag phyin ci ma log pa bsnyan pa/ 347pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa gang yin pa de nyid rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab byams pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te khong du chud par bya'o/ /de la sgrib pa kun ni nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pas bsdus pa ste sa bon dang bcas pa yin la/ de dag kun gyi dri ma dang bral ba ni spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de yang gzod ma nas rang gi sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing 'od gsal ba nyid sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang dbyer med pa mngon du gyur pa ni ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de ltar spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa de nyid ni chos kyi sku yin te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang me long lta bu'i ye shes la chos kyi sku khyab pa rtag pa 'dus ma byas pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ yul chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang yul can rig pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi yul du gyur pa'o/ /de nyid la ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'am rtogs bya chos kyi dbyings don dam pa dang kun rdzob mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ kun rdzob mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis ni shes bya thams cad la chags pa med cing thogs pa med par cig car rnam par mi rtog bzhin du ma 'dres par mkhyen la/ de yang de kho na nyid du na nam mkha' ltar spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings ji lta ba bzhin du thugs su chud pa yin no/ /don 'di la dgongs nas rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos las/ ji skad du/rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod gang yin nyi dang mkha' bzhin glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa sprin tshogs stug po yis ni bsgribs gyur pa/ /

348 chosabazhi'i 'grel ba snying po gsal ba'i rgyan/dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni chos la mi rtog rnam 'byed ye shes dag la brten nas thob/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di dag ye shes nyid dang / spangs pa dang / de'i khyad par gyi rgyu dang gsum gyis bstan pa dang / 'di ltar ye shes rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu sangs rgyas kyi chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa dang dbyer med pa de dang / glo bur gyi sgrib pa gnyis sprin gyi tshogs stug po dang bral ba'i nam mkha' rab tu dwangs pa lta bu'i spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub chen po de ni/ rgyu mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'jig rten lasa'adas pa dang / rjes las thob pa dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes gnyis kyis thob pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas dbyingasadang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sku 'di la dgongs nas/sangs rgyas gzugs su mi lta mtshan rnams dang / /rus dang rigs su ma yin 'od dang ni/ /rnam shes yid kyis rab tu phye ma yin/ /chos nyid gang de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de nyid la dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang chub chen po zhes bya ste/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'am/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing rnam par dag pa de nyid/ ji skad du bstan pa'i lam gyis btsal bas rnam par dag ste glo bur gyi dri ma las
